title: bev_fusion target: precompute, input interface, modular network, output interface, removable post-processing
subtitle: Proposal for discussion (2026-11-01, not built). Left of the input interface nothing learns; between the two interfaces every slot is a swappable block with a stated contract (the base chain has no rule step there); right of the output interface only rule steps for metrics and the prototype. Each box names the code it is built from today.

pre.label: precompute: deterministic, cached with an identity, no weights learned before it

interface.label: interface: one typed contract (names, shapes, units, frames)

nodes.label:
Cameras
now + past frames
nodes.note: today the front camera; six cameras are one more entry of the interface, not a new chain

nodes.label:
Radars
detections, 0.5 s
nodes.note: all five radars

nodes.label:
Ego motion
poses / CAN
nodes.note: from the poses in nuScenes; a deployed system supplies its own odometry

nodes.label:
Image features
frozen encoder, cached
nodes.note: frozen DualBEV / BEVFusion image heads: depth probabilities + context per pixel; while frozen they are a cache (with a meta.json identity), once unfrozen the image encoder becomes the first network slot

nodes.label:
Radar points to now
pose + Doppler, cached
nodes.note: the sweeps of 0.5 s compensated to the current time and cached as points (not as a grid): the radar slot keeps the choice of raster or point encoder

nodes.label:
Ego steps, calibration
(dt, v, omega), K, T
nodes.note: the ego step from every past frame to now, the true gap to the target time, the memory step between calls, camera and radar calibration, the image crop; today partly built in train.py from the GT meta (also at evaluation)

nodes.label:
INPUT INTERFACE
BEVInputs (typed dict + check): image features, lane image, K, T, ida, radar points, ego steps, gaps, flip
nodes.note: today an untyped batch dict plus the forward arguments dts, state, step and ego; proposed: one typed dict with names, shapes, units and frames and a check(); the per-sample flip flag travels with it (the mirror itself happens in BEV, after the camera slot)

nodes.label:
Camera BEV encoder
lift + collapse; mirror in BEV
nodes.note: contract: BEVInputs -> (BEVs (B, F, C_cam, X, Y), visibility (B, 1, X, Y)), mirrored in BEV for flipped samples (cached perspective features cannot be mirrored); kinds dualbev, bevfusion, dual

nodes.label:
Radar BEV encoder
raster + convs | pillars | off
nodes.note: contract: radar points -> (B, C_rad, X, Y); the raster is the first op, before any weight, so it costs no gradient; radar history is the sweeps inside the points

nodes.label:
Temporal fusion
window + memory | GRU | none
nodes.note: contract: (BEV now, past BEVs with their ego steps, state, step since the last call, visibility) -> (BEV, state); the memory re-centre is a whole-cell roll: the gradient passes, the shift comes from the ego pose

nodes.label:
Fusion
concat | gate
nodes.note: contract: (camera BEV, radar BEV) -> (B, C_fuse, X, Y); modality dropout lives here (off when a sensor is off)

nodes.label:
BEV backbone + neck
ResNet + FPN | SECOND | CMX
nodes.note: contract: (B, C_fuse, X, Y) -> features S (B, C, X, Y), the optional 1x1 head reduction included; CMX replaces fusion and backbone together (a kind of this slot that takes both branch BEVs)

nodes.label:
Time mover
velocity + ego splat
nodes.note: moves S to a target time dt for every head (shared) and gives the velocity field v_hat at dt = 0

nodes.label:
Map head
layers per dt
nodes.note: contract: (S moved to dt) -> map probabilities (B, L, X, Y); the aux heads read the branch BEVs, not S (training only)

nodes.label:
Object head
CenterPoint maps per dt
nodes.note: contract: (S moved to dt) -> heatmap, offset, size, yaw, velocity, moving maps; the refiner (option, off in the base chain) decodes top-k and matches the GT inside the training path: a rule step when it is on

nodes.label:
Planner head
(later)
nodes.note: reads the features S and the dense outputs; trained jointly, its loss flows back through backbone, fusion and encoders: the deep connection to the fusion

nodes.label:
OUTPUT INTERFACE
maps, object maps per dt, v_hat, features S, state
nodes.note: what the planner, the one loss module (BEVLoss) and the post-processing read: dense and differentiable

nodes.label:
Line extraction
zero crossing
nodes.note: for the line metric and the prototype only

nodes.label:
Box decode
peak, top-k, threshold
nodes.note: for the detection metrics and the prototype; the refiner option also calls it on the training path

nodes.label:
Trainer + config
builder table per slot
nodes.note: proposed: the flat ModelConfig stays; the if-chains of the constructor become one {kind: builder} table per slot and one build check

nodes.label:
Loss
BEVLoss + Kendall
nodes.note: one module: the Kendall weights and the cross-head terms (motion and time consistency, refine) stay together; heads declare their output keys

nodes.label:
Lane add-on (option)
stride 4, after temporal
nodes.note: reads the lane image, K, T, ida and the DualBEV depth of the current frame; its BEV is added to the camera BEV after the temporal block; mirrored on its own

groups.label: 3 network: one slot per block, the kind chosen in the config, a contract test per kind

not_drawn.training/temporal.py: older multi-hypothesis temporal propagation, superseded by temporal_fusion.py; imported only by tests and scratch
not_drawn.training/radar_encoder.py: delta-coded slot raster of plan 3.4, not imported by model.py or train.py
not_drawn.training/legacy: S1 single-sensor pipeline and the t4 DualBEV front; nothing in model / train / evaluation imports it
